service.name: Wedding music in Colorado
service.serviceType: Live music for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours and receptions
service.description: Acoustic and Spanish guitar for the ceremony, a jazz or acoustic duo for the cocktail hour, and a DJ for the reception, booked on one contract across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: Can one booking cover the ceremony and the cocktail hour?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's the most common way to book it here. The same musicians walk from the ceremony space to wherever cocktails are happening, on one contract and one invoice, which also covers the gap while the couple is away for photographs. Signet Artists books wedding musicians across Denver and the Colorado mountains.

faqs.q: Do we need a band for the whole wedding?
faqs.a: Most Colorado weddings are better served with live musicians for the ceremony and the cocktail hour, where volume and attention need a person reading the crowd, and a DJ for the reception, where a floor has to stay full for hours.
The ceremony and the cocktail hour are gentle enough that guests greet and talk over them without raising their voices. The reception plays like a dance floor, up to what the venue allows.

faqs.q: What paperwork comes with the booking?
faqs.a: A certificate of insurance naming the venue, a W-9 and one itemized invoice come in the same email as the contract, and a named contact with a mobile number in writing is reachable from setup to pack-down. Every size comes with sound and setup.

faqs.q: Do you play outdoor weddings in Colorado?
faqs.a: Yes, and most of them are outdoors. Outdoors adds three requirements at any size: a covered, level and dry performance area, power run to it, and a move-indoors call written before the day, because Colorado evenings get cold fast after sunset.
